turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My old daypack is falling apart and I've narrowed the new one down, can you help me pick?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me describe everything first, and then I'll ask for your thoughts.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a tiny twenty litre one, super light, just enough room for water, a jacket and lunch.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then a thirty litre pack with a proper hip belt and a mesh back so you don't get a sweaty back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And a bigger forty litre pack that would also work for overnight trips, but it's heavier and costs more.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all. Which sounds best to you?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Go for the thirty litre. The mesh back makes a real difference on warm days, and you won't miss the extra space of the big one for day trips.
